Page 41 Cont.
Apr. 11 Peter Mouseau - 67 of Windsor, diabetis very poorly
Harry Dettloff - 37 - 2-3 yrs. paralysis - has wife and two small ..... Father Sick
Elliott Williams - 33 - Nerveous break. was in Ypsilanti a year, etc now home but while harmless is not - himself. ..
Gean Cavonagh
Page 42
James Bartholemew - 59 - Episcop. One eye gone - other weak ..
Apr. 15 John G. Bickle - 27 - in Dearborn over a week sick since before Xmas worrying
Baby Christine Glowe - 18 mo. - fell out of the high chair and frac- tured spine - in Providence 5 weeks
Charlotte Nelson - 4 - brain injury at birth, still unable to talk - father is Lutheran - Drs predicted she'd never walk - She walks now - Enrolled
16 Mary Kluhm - 22 - Hip-Cancer from fall 6 mo. ago.
May Collin - 60 - fell day before new yrs. - almost broke her back - rooming with "unity scientists", ... refused to anything. Elderly couple .... no charity though reading the "bible" frequently
17 Timothy Burke - 57 - a twin - in Ann Arbor Hosp .... Cancer of stomach feared ... Enrolled To-day. Sister promising perpetual. Has wife and five small ch. depending -
Page 43 Apr. 17 Irene Mc Kay of Saginaw enrolled about March 28 last year as against general paralysis. Drs had given no hope ... Prayers were asked besides; She asks now here present for prayers of thanksgiving for her great im- provement .... expects soon to go back to work
Harvey Fisher -27 - Northville ..... now T.B. ulcers of Stomach .. rather hopeless - mother etc asks for P ......
Mrs Bertha Thomas - 52 - Cancer (of rectum) ... fears operation - a widow has one son.
